name: Narukami
source:
[i]"You and I are nothing more than cogs in the machinery, each one serving its own role."[/i]

A resident of Itehari. He's known the heroine since she was a child, and occasionally bumps into her in town. Where he lives and what he does for a living is a mystery.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
